info.description: Connects this computer to Onsay, so Onsay answers what you ask in the chat, your other devices can reach this computer, and the programs on it can ask Onsay for help. Its lingos ask Onsay with lingo(...) and use(...), and /onsay takes prompts from anyone with its prompt key, each answered by Onsay.

settings.name: token
settings.title: Sign in
settings.about: This computer's sign in to Onsay, kept by onsay-core <settings> call onsay.sign_in or by the Onsay app.

settings.name: prompt_key
settings.title: Prompt key
settings.about: What a program sends as Authorization: Bearer <prompt key> to prompt this computer at /onsay. Made on its first start.
